title: Low-Overhead Surface Code with Delayed Atom-Loss Detection via Pauli Envelope
summary: Atom loss is a major error source in neutral-atom quantum computers, accounting for over 40% of the total physical errors in recent experiments. Its nonlinear and correlated nature poses significant challenges: current syndrome extraction circuits require additional overhead or sacrifice loss tolerance, and existing decoders are computationally inefficient, suboptimal, or lack provable guarantees.
